card.title: The System Works
card.instruction: Celebrate every queue, delay, review, and formal approval as proof that a dependable system is protecting everyone from chaos.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our street-party application has reached a third committee. Reassuring to have so many safeguards.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The first two lost it. I need to book the tables today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And a third stands ready. One lost envelope can't plunge the street into chaos.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They want a fresh application. The table company won't hold our booking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good thing approval comes first. I'll reapply; you release the tables. Imagine seating everyone before we're protected.

mechanism: A interprets repeated committee loss and a fresh application as reassuring safeguards, sacrificing a booking rather than act before approval.
confusable: Unlike blind optimism about any event, A specifically values the formal delay and review as protection from disorder.
comparison: The party alternative restarts approval despite losing the table booking; the stall alternative embraces six-week review from home.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
